ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent system that monitors real-time IoT sensor streams, detects equipment anomalies, and executes automated remediation workflows via LangGraph and LLM reasoning.
ideas.problem_statement: Autonomous AI Agents for Intelligent Real-World Decision-Making
ideas.title: Agentic Multi-Agent IoT Diagnostic & Closed-Loop Ops Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven architecture of a multi-agent IoT diagnostic platform that won 3rd place at SEAL Hackathon 2026, targeting judges who value complex autonomous reasoning and practical workflow automation.

ideas.pitch: A natural language interface for robotic arms and rover units that translates unstructured spoken or typed user commands into executable, sequence-checked ROS2 navigation and manipulation paths.
ideas.problem_statement: Intelligent Autonomous Machines for Real-World Physical Challenges
ideas.title: Embodied AI Robotic Task Planner and Conversational Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on the winning pattern of 'Chat-with-your-robot' from the Robotics Collective Hackathon, giving software teams bridging into hardware a massive edge in human-robot interaction.

ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted pre-flight mission planning and safety layer for autonomous drones that parses airspace regulations, checks sensor telemetry, and generates verified flight scripts.
ideas.problem_statement: Intelligent Autonomous Machines for Real-World Physical Challenges
ideas.title: Autonomous Drone Pre-Flight Safety & Regulatory Compliance Daemon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of the TechnoFest Hackathon winner 'Airguard-Daemons', demonstrating immediate commercial utility in drone safety and autonomous flight governance.

ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision system running on edge hardware that detects industrial safety breaches, missing PPE, and hazard zones, triggering instant automated supervisor alerts.
ideas.problem_statement: Intelligent Autonomous Machines for Real-World Physical Challenges
ideas.title: Edge AI Industrial Safety Violation & PPE Detection System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven edge-AI methodology from hackathon-winning industrial safety projects, appealing heavily to judges looking for immediate real-world enterprise deployment viability.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent ground rover built with LIDAR and camera feeds that autonomously navigates unmapped indoor environments, dynamically re-planning paths around sudden physical obstacles.
ideas.problem_statement: Intelligent Autonomous Machines for Real-World Physical Challenges
ideas.title: Autonomous Indoor Mapping & Obstacle-Avoidance Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact hardware validation blueprint of the Quanta International Hackathon first-prize winning rover, ensuring a captivating live physical demonstration for the judging panel.
